title: “ work books cost 29.99 euro” I charged 60.99 euro
body: I recently encountered a disappointing experience with the Habio app. After discovering the app through an advertisement on Instagram, I decided to explore it by taking advantage of their 1 euro trial offer. My intent was to evaluate the app as a potential tool for my students to build better habit routines. However, within minutes of signing up, I was unexpectedly charged 69.99 euros. Upon contacting customer support, I learned that this charge was for downloading two PDFs within the app. To my surprise, the cost breakdown suggested that each PDF, with only about 30 pages, was valued at nearly 30 euros—essentially charging 1 euro per page. This pricing seems excessively high for what is provided, especially when considering that it was not clearly communicated upfront. As someone who frequently tests educational tools and apps, I find this pricing structure unreasonable and not justifiable. If books or resources for building habits were priced this way, they would be inaccessible to many. Unfortunately, this experience has left me with a negative impression of Habio, and I cannot recommend it to others, especially those who are mindful of their budgets.

title: Abbonamento accreditato ingiustamente
body: Avevo selezionato un abbonamento per 3 giorni pagando. Oggi automaticamente mi è stato accreditato l’abbonamento annuale senza he vi fosse specificato il cambio di piano e senza che io adesso abbia la possibilità di retrocedere ed essere rimborsata. Ieri stesso ho controllato tra gli abbonamenti/ rinnovo delle app e questa non mi appariva quindi mi sono fidata. Invece mi hanno accreditato il costo annuale senza che io lo avessi chiesto. Richiedo urgentemente un refound. Sono molto delusa. Ovviamente nella sezione abbonamenti del telefono è come se non esistesse (infatti non veniva indicato nemmeno il “rinnovo”)
